# ADR NNNN: short decision title

- Status: Proposed / Accepted / Superseded
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Owner:

## Context
What decision is required? What has been observed and verified?

## Decision
What choice was made and by whom?

## Alternatives considered
Which credible options were evaluated, and why rejected?

## Consequences
Benefits, costs, new risks, migration/rollback considerations.

## Verification and references
Files, tests, measurements, sources. Distinguish planned from run checks.
